entities.summary: Naoya Inoue  is a Japanese professional boxer. He has held multiple world championships in four weight classes, and is one of only three male boxers in history to become the undisputed champion in two weight classes in the "four-belt era". Nicknamed "the Monster", Inoue is known for his exceptional punching power, possessing a knockout-to-win percentage of 84.375%.
